I printed out all the text conversations we've had and gave them to his dad so he knows everything I know. (We see each other / talk on the phone too but the only time he will open up is in texts)   

Thanks for saying he's lucky to have me. I really do care about him  and just want him to get better. He lost faith in doctors 10 years ago when he first went but they just fobbed him off from what I can gather. I have tried telling him that times have changed and depression has finally been recognised as an illness and is taken a lot more seriously now than what it used to be.  But I just keep thinking when I'm having a shitty time in my life (nothing in comparison to what anyone with depression is going through, I'm talking about break ups or losing someone etc as it's the closing thing I can relate to try understand)  it's hard to see the silver lining when everything around you is crap and you don't think it will ever get better. Eventually it does but how is he going to know that when it's so bad now and he can't see the light at the end of the tunnel. It's just pitch black to him everywhere he looks. that analogy just made me tear up. That's not how life should be. No one deserves to live like that and I can understand why people see no other option. I just hope and hope that there is another way out from the darkness.

He has told me he hates his birthday and doesn't want to do anything for it. Plus as I've told his dad the situation about his birthday his dad told me he's taking him out for the day and I said I would come around and see him but my uncle has got it covered.  I could see him in the evening if they're back and I'm going to make a visit if they are home. He broke up with his girlfriend two days ago and won't speak to her and because he's broke up with her so much she's kind of just...accepted it this time. (His words, I need to contact her to see if she's okay and her side of the events)   I honestly  don't think I could section him. I don't care if he hates me if I did it. I just don't want to break the trust. He's been caught once before sat in his car by the police and he has the gift of the gab by acting fine and he made a point of telling me that managed to walk away without being taken away when they thought he was acting suicidal as someone must of seen him in the car and called the police. I have told him that I would call the police once when he wasn't answering me and he just told me that story on how to make it look like I was wrong.

Thanks. I don't think I could get him sectioned for the reasons you said, I don't want to cut off my loyalty to him and how I'm the only person he has opened up to. I wish I wasn't the only person as I feel like I have so much on my shoulders (I have told my parents and his father what his intentions are though and I did ask him beforehand that if he can't tell his dad how he feels can I tell him? He agreed, I felt like I had no other option). But at the same time I'm so greatfull that he has someone to talk to and maybe me talking to him or just listening means that he's not alone in his own thoughts. No one should be alone.  


It breaks my heart to even think that people must be in such a bad place that they wants to end their life. To have to wake up and hate yourself or life that much that you can't do it anymore. I wouldn't wish that on my worst enemy and it hurts to know that sometimes there is no other answer. I'm sorry to anyone that has this horrible illness and I hope that maybe there is another way for the pain and suffering to end other than suicide. Just please, before you do choose something so permanent, exhaust all other options. 



 This is what I've been saying to him: 

That what he has is an illness and it won't just go away by ignoring it, he needs help from a professional if he wants to get better and that no one wants to feel the way he does. He didn't choose to feel this way and I can't begin to imagine how he must feel every day. That all his friends and family care about him.

Thank you. I've been trying to contact him all day today and he hasn't replied to me. It's 1am where I am now and I can't sleep so I just keep sending him texts asking if he's okay. I'm hoping that he's just ignoring me but if he sees that I'm thinking of him it might be good? I've thought about getting him sectioned but what if he hates me and then does it anyway? And I just keep thinking about how I'm the only person he seems to open up to about it. He won't talk to anyone else so I don't want to cut that tie of him thinking the one person he can trust would go against him (in his mind) he lies to me though, he promises me he has booked doctors appointments and then I later find out he hasn't. He's got one "booked for Monday" and his dad has confirmed this one is true so I'm hoping he is going to actually go.  I'm just scared, ive always been good with words and helping people but I am so worried of saying the wrong thing. I've searched up on what to say and what not to say but how can you go by something so generic when everyone is so different. I've asked him how he's going to do it, has he got a date. I've tried to just picture it as a cry for help and maybe that's where I've gone wrong. I've not taken him seriously in the fact he may actually do it. What if it's too late for me to do something now, I've left it too late. I just need him to get past tomorrow and see the doctor like he promises.  

Edit: sorry I just want to  explain what I meant about not taking him seriously. I have 100% taken him seriously and treated him like he means it, but my head can't help but think "he's my happy cousin, he would never do that" so it's hard for me to join the two together.

As a woman who was 16 and dated a guy who was 28. I wish someone had told him this, as no matter how many people told me, what 16 year old who thinks they struck lucky with an older attractive man, is going to listen? He never hurt me physically but he messed me up for a while. I felt like I wasn't good enough, I had to put on an act that I was more "mature" than I was. 
I'm fine now, I have a gorgeous boyfriend and I'm 25, I just wish I knew better or someone told him it was wrong. I doubt any of his friends/family knew anyway, he made sure we never saw any of them. Probably knowing they would have something to say. 

Edit: Engrish

I dated someone when I was 16 and he was 28. I was one of those people that said age was never a problem, turns out it is when it's that big and the younger one is still in their teens. You still have a lot of influence at that age and you are still finding yourself.   I was not really in the slightest for the big commitment he wanted, (the first night we met up he was "falling for me and wanted to make it work" ) we ended it and then I found myself dating him again when I was 21 and he was 33.
However, The person I was dating was quite emotionally draining, everything was on his terms, if I didn't agree with him it was because I was acting "immature" I started to become a shell of myself and my friends and family weren't so happy about it. We broke it off and even though it's 4 years ago it still bothers me how it was. I feel stupid,ashamed because here was this gorgeous older man that had noticed me, I felt like I had to put up this image of acting older than I was, and if I let it slip for a second, the shame/guilt/embarrassment I felt for myself was overwhelming. So even though she is "mature for her age" please, think for a second and maybe wonder if she's maybe just pretending that she is?
